description: Implementation of the ImageManager class for managing graphic buffer caching and threading in the Android RenderEngine's OpenGL rendering engine.

classes.name: ImageManager
classes.description: Manages image buffers, including caching, threading, and synchronization for rendering.

methods.name: initThread
methods.description: Initializes and starts the thread for image management, setting thread name and scheduling policy.

methods.name: cacheAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously caches a graphic buffer with an associated barrier.

methods.name: cache
methods.description: Synchronously caches a graphic buffer, waiting for the operation to complete.

methods.name: releaseAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously releases a buffer by its ID with an associated barrier.

methods.name: queueOperation
methods.description: Queues a cache or release operation for processing by the thread.

methods.name: threadMain
methods.description: Main loop of the image management thread, processing queued operations.
